title: ETag & Cache Validation
definition: An ETag (Entity Tag) is an HTTP header containing a unique hash of a file's contents. When a cached file expires, the browser sends the ETag back to the server (`If-None-Match`). If the file hasn't changed, the server returns a 304 Not Modified, saving massive bandwidth.
simpleExplanation: The browser asks: 'Hey, I have a file with the fingerprint 12345. Is it still the newest version?' The server says: 'Yes, don't redownload it.'
diagramContent:
sequenceDiagram
  participant B as Browser
  participant S as Server
  Note over B: Cache expired for style.css
  B->>S: GET /style.css
  B->>S: Header: If-None-Match: "xyz123"
  Note over S: Compares ETag
  S-->>B: HTTP 304 Not Modified
  Note over B: Uses local cached file
